objective: Evaluate whether lineage-aware evidence aggregation reduces false assurance in vacancy authorization verification.

stripe_main.role: main cohort; independent evaluation of evidence aggregation

naukri_separate.role: separate lineage experiment only; never merged with Stripe benchmark

B_ordinary_evidence_aggregation.rule: Aggregate evidence per case without correcting for shared source or copy lineage.
B_ordinary_evidence_aggregation.risk: Can count repeated same-source or copied evidence as independent support.

C_lineage_aware_aggregation.rule: Deduplicate evidence by source family and lineage group; require independent source support for positive authorization; retain unresolved when evidence is incomplete.

split_protocol.grouping: Keep exact duplicates, near-duplicate clusters, lineage candidates, and shared source families within one split.
split_protocol.recommended_split: grouped train/validation/test split after adjudication; test set frozen before model tuning
leakage_controls: fit text normalization/vectorizers on train only
do not use post-retrieval labels as features before their allowed time
do not split copied descriptions across folds
do not merge Naukri and Stripe
split_protocol.current_status: No supervised split or model evaluation should be run until human ground truth exists.

metrics.false_assurance_rate: Unsupported positive authorization conclusions divided by all positive authorization conclusions.
metrics.precision: True supported authorization conclusions divided by all positive authorization conclusions.
metrics.recall: True supported authorization conclusions divided by all adjudicated supported authorization cases.
metrics.f1: Harmonic mean of precision and recall.
metrics.specificity: Correct non-supported/unresolved decisions divided by all adjudicated non-supported cases.
metrics.unresolved_decision_rate: Unresolved outputs divided by all evaluated cases.
metrics.coverage: Cases receiving a non-unresolved conclusion divided by all evaluated cases.
metrics.contradiction_handling: Report explicit contradictions separately; do not fold unavailable evidence into contradiction.
metrics.repost_performance: Report metrics separately for adjudicated lineage/repost groups and non-lineage cases.
metrics.incomplete_evidence_performance: Report unresolved rate and false-assurance rate for incomplete/unavailable evidence strata.

comparability_rule: All three approaches use the same adjudicated case IDs, split assignments, and target definition; only inputs and aggregation logic differ.
no_metric_claim_rule: Do not calculate meaningful supervised precision, recall, F1, specificity, or false-assurance rates until ground truth is independently adjudicated.
